description: Evidence-backed inventory of every current regions.json entry whose kind is not semantic. Region tuples inherit category, evidence, and revisit fields from their group.

compiler_crt_runtime.meaning: Assembly region proven byte-identical to a VC7.1 toolkit library section outside that object section's relocation fields.
compiler_crt_runtime.inclusion_rule: Current manifest kind=asm and a unique address in the match_crt.py report.
compiler_crt_runtime.does_not_mean: A source-level game implementation is impossible; the vendor library is the authoritative implementation.

embedded_text_data.meaning: Non-instruction bytes embedded in the PE .text section and emitted by a byte overlay.
embedded_text_data.inclusion_rule: Current manifest kind=data with a matching text_data source annotation.
embedded_text_data.does_not_mean: The bytes are a C++ object with a recovered semantic type.

alignment_padding.meaning: Non-instruction filler retained to preserve retail section layout and alignment.
alignment_padding.inclusion_rule: Current manifest kind=padding with source evidence describing CC/00, MSVC NOP, separator, raw-tail, or disassembly boundary bytes.
alignment_padding.does_not_mean: Every byte sequence resembling padding is safe without boundary/control-flow evidence.

game_code_still_recoverable.meaning: Known-domain non-CRT assembly that remains a recovery target; it is not a claim that a plain TU or current C++ spelling already matches.
game_code_still_recoverable.inclusion_rule: Current manifest kind=asm, source outside src/unidentified/, not in the exact CRT or fixed-body evidence sets.
game_code_still_recoverable.does_not_mean: A failed source attempt proves irreducibility.

exact_assembly_required.meaning: Current exact-output route has a documented fixed-body/toolchain blocker: fsincos bytes or the register-preserving tail trampoline.
exact_assembly_required.inclusion_rule: The exact retail byte pattern is present and the cited experiments/disassembly rule out the current standalone C++ route.
exact_assembly_required.does_not_mean: The region can never be replaced: a new compiler, manifest capability, merge, or native-LTCG route may change this status.

unclassified_assembly.meaning: Current assembly with insufficient positive evidence to call it vendor runtime, known-domain recoverable game code, or fixed-body assembly.
unclassified_assembly.inclusion_rule: Current manifest kind=asm, source under src/unidentified/, and not in the exact CRT or fixed-body evidence sets.
unclassified_assembly.does_not_mean: It is CRT, game code, or irreducible; this is an evidence hold.

E-CRT-MATCH.validation: All unique report addresses are present in the live manifest as kind=asm, owner=address, with the same size; duplicate rows from equivalent libraries are counted once by address.

E-DATA-DEFINED.claim: The source overlay declares the exact byte range and records text_range_map:defined_data plus full+augmented listing typed data.

E-DATA-TABLE.claim: 0x00450730..0x0045216F is documented as 420 repeating 16-byte records with repeated .rdata pointers, monotonic selectors, no code xref to the table start, and no instruction promotion.

E-PADDING-CC.claim: The source annotation records repeated CC/00 or an inspected INT3 run at a boundary; bytes are retained verbatim and not promoted.

E-PADDING-LIVE-MISSED.claim: Live Ghidra identified INT3/NOP bytes inside a missed-code candidate; source retains them without instruction promotion.

E-PADDING-LIVE-UNRESOLVED.claim: Live Ghidra identified INT3/NOP bytes inside an unresolved range; source retains them without instruction promotion.

E-PADDING-SEP.claim: A single INT3 follows authenticated RET/JMP at a function/basic-block boundary.

E-PADDING-NOP90.claim: Exact MSVC alignment NOP encoding, retail byte 0x90, with neighboring authenticated unconditional JMP/RET.

E-PADDING-NOP-8D4900.claim: Exact MSVC alignment NOP encoding, retail bytes 0x8D4900, with neighboring authenticated unconditional JMP/RET.

E-PADDING-NOP-8BFF.claim: Exact MSVC alignment NOP encoding, retail bytes 0x8BFF, with neighboring authenticated unconditional JMP/RET.

E-PADDING-GROW-TRAP.claim: Padding follows the compiler-generated Grow catch-all trap.

E-PADDING-TAIL.claim: The span is the PE .text raw tail beyond virtual_size 0x00465A80 and is zero-filled.

E-GAME-DOMAIN.claim: The source is in the known game/render/script/math/platform/app/archive/util domains; no exact CRT or fixed-body evidence promoted it.

E-FSINCOS.claim: The current oracle scan finds eight 30-byte regions containing opcode d9 fb; the cited VC7.1 TU and /GL+/LTCG experiments emit separate fsin/fcos for all tested source forms and the CRT libraries contain no d9 fb.

E-TRAMPOLINE.claim: The current oracle scan finds seven 7-byte bodies beginning 8b c1 e9 (mov eax,ecx; jmp rel32). The target consumes EAX and the documented C++ route emits push/call/ret or a bare jump; W308 records merge/EAX/LTCG as future routes, so this is fixed under the current standalone route, not a universal impossibility claim.

E-PENDING-ASM.claim: The evidence is deliberately insufficient for a stronger classification; no runtime, game-domain, or fixed-body claim is made.

E-RECOVERY-TITLE-OPTIONS.claim: The note reconstructs the handler behavior and coupled timer/animation topology; 0x0042D920 remains retail assembly pending a topology-safe semantic route. It makes no irreducibility claim.

E-RECOVERY-STAGE-TIP.claim: The note records the restored naked retail body and an exact focused probe, plus the semantic model, ABI constraints, and next experiment. Semantic recovery is not integrated; no irreducibility claim is made.

E-RECOVERY-ENTITY-SWEEP.claim: The note records agreed behavior but a NOT PROBED 585-byte production asm body, with a proposed focused candidate and dependencies. It makes no exact or irreducibility claim.

E-RECOVERY-TRIGGER-REGION.claim: The note records a NON-EXACT semantic candidate and restored 471-byte production asm, with the next compiler/layout dependency. The ordinary failed candidate is not treated as irreducibility evidence.

E-RECOVERY-ARCHIVE-CURSOR.claim: The note records the exact semantic promotion of 0x00434F30; the promoted region is excluded from this non-semantic ledger.

E-RECOVERY-SCORE-ARCHIVE.claim: The note records the exact semantic promotion of 0x00436000; the promoted region is excluded from this non-semantic ledger.

E-RECOVERY-CAMERA-VIEWPORT.claim: The camera/viewport lane records ordinary semantic/compiler mismatches with production asm restored; it makes no exact-assembly-required claim.

E-RECOVERY-RENDER-EFFECT.claim: The note records the exact semantic promotion of 0x00442F50; the promoted region is excluded from this non-semantic ledger.

E-RECOVERY-ENTITY-PLAYER.claim: The note records exact semantic proof and the behavioral rename of already-semantic 0x00405730; the region is excluded from this non-semantic ledger.

E-RECOVERY-D3D-LOGGER.claim: The note records the exact semantic promotion of 0x0044B810; the promoted region is excluded from this non-semantic ledger.

E-RECOVERY-LEAVES.claim: The note records the exact semantic promotions of 0x0044D300, 0x0044D370, 0x0044D550, 0x0044D5D0, 0x0044D600, and 0x0044DCA0; the promoted regions are excluded from this non-semantic ledger.

E-RECOVERY-JOYSTICK-LOGGER.claim: The note records the native-LTCG caller/callee ABI experiment and exact semantic promotion of 0x0044A0C0; both the 105-byte joystick probe and the 201-byte logger contribution are byte-exact.

revisit_catalog.R-CRT: Rerun match_crt.py against the current manifest/oracle/toolkit; promote or demote only on a unique non-relocation match and record the new report hash.
revisit_catalog.R-DATA: Recheck source range comments against Ghidra/IDA data boundaries and xrefs; if code or a typed data owner is proven, split/reclassify the overlay.
revisit_catalog.R-PADDING: Recheck boundary control flow and bytes; if a reachable instruction or non-filler data is proven, remove the padding classification and preserve exact extents.
revisit_catalog.R-GAME: Use the per-unit probe/vdiff and the documented native-LTCG/whole-program routes; only a verified exact match changes the live manifest kind.
revisit_catalog.R-FIXED: A new compiler/toolchain, manifest fixed-body support, fragment merge, or native-LTCG cluster must produce the exact bytes and pass the byte gate before demotion.
revisit_catalog.R-PENDING: First establish provenance from CRT matching, source-domain ownership, IDA/Ghidra boundaries, or a repeated compiler experiment; do not infer irreducibility from an ordinary failed C++ attempt.
